_meta.purpose: Conformance golden fixture for one shipped connector. Locks the connector's per-concept conformance declaration and carries the raw->concept mapping cases that prove any mapper is correct. The CI gate (tests/contract/test_r2_0_b4_t5_conformance_fixtures.py) fails if a shipped connector has no fixture here.
_meta.note: concepts[] mirrors discovery/concepts/conformance.py and is pinned to it by the gate — a registry change without a fixture change fails.

actor_group.reason: a channel is a group-shaped container ('team' type), NOT a work queue — a detector must not read queue semantics into it

approval.reason: the source has no approval concept — it records content/activity, not gated decisions

assignment.reason: the source has no unit-of-work record; its signal is content or events, not tracked work
